## Biographical Information

(b. Otterbourne 1860/1)

mistress of Otterbourne school

The wife of [Alfred Rolfe](person_1256.qmd) and daughter of Robert Misselbrook, shoemaker, of Otterbourne, she was mistress of the infant school at Otterbourne, until she gave it up on marrying Alfred Rolfe, the schoolmaster in 1888.  She was the youngest sister of Ellen Misselbrook. [1861 census, Otterbourne; 1891 census]
